From: myersgene@comcast.net <myersgene@comcast.net> 
Sent: Monday, April 6, 2020 4:39 PM
To: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>
Subject: MORE KALINE PIECES
CHRIS: Two more Kaline pieces that I did in March. Plus, there’s a sub of Kaline/Howe piece I sent last year.

I also attached my outline for the “Mr. Tiger: The Legend of Al Kaline” book. (Guess there won’t be a true funeral with scores of dignitaries, eh? Or a public viewing at Comerica.) Every piece that has a DONE is something I have sent you and something you can post at will. (There are three pieces I have never written, as you’ll see.)
Way to beat the uniform pants off the competition, Chris!
Please give me a ring when you can. Anything I could do to help right this minute?
